title: 1.3 Impacts of Biology and Technology
description: Positive and negative impacts of biology and technology on society and the natural world

questions.question: The impacts of biology and technology refer to ____.
options: the number of new devices produced each year
the cost of developing scientific instruments
the study of the distribution of species
factors that pose positive or negative effects on the society and the natural world
questions.correctAnswer: factors that pose positive or negative effects on the society and the natural world

questions.question: The advancements of biological information and technological devices can ____ the societal and natural world.
Ensuring food security is a positive impact of biology that results from ____.
Medicine and disease treatments have resulted in ____.
Biology has helped achieve a better supply of ____.
An increase in industrial production is due to ____.
Antibiotics are created to treat ____.
Which of the following is a negative impact of biology on the natural world?
options: Creating antibiotics to treat bacterial infections
Improving health and longevity through medicine
Biological weapon production and use that destroy the natural world
Ensuring food security through increased productivity
questions.correctAnswer: Biological weapon production and use that destroy the natural world

questions.question: Practicing a predetermined limit to have only boys (XY males) and avoid females (XX females) would lead to ____.
In the textbook, XY and XX refer to the ____ of children.
Technology has damaged our world in two main ways: ____.
options: pollution and the depletion of natural resources
questions.correctAnswer: pollution and the depletion of natural resources

questions.question: Industrial emissions and effluents pollute ____.
Industrialization and subsequent technological advancements have resulted in ____.
options: the misuse and destruction of our natural environment
questions.correctAnswer: the misuse and destruction of our natural environment

questions.question: Biochemical agents, pesticides and fertilizers cause ____.
The impact of biology refers to ____.
options: the effects arising from the advancement of biological knowledge and innovations
the number of biologists in a country
questions.correctAnswer: the effects arising from the advancement of biological knowledge and innovations

questions.question: Technological devices made from biological materials can provide services that ____.
options: only increase the cost of living
influence, treat, and control the society and the natural world negatively or positively
questions.correctAnswer: influence, treat, and control the society and the natural world negatively or positively

questions.question: Creating antibiotics to treat bacterial infections is ____.
Producing and using biological weapons is ____.
options: a negative impact of biology on the natural world
a positive impact of biology on society
questions.correctAnswer: a negative impact of biology on the natural world

questions.question: Improved health and increased longevity are the results of ____.
The increase in industrial production made possible by microbial action is ____.
options: a positive impact of biology on the natural world
questions.correctAnswer: a positive impact of biology on the natural world

questions.question: Pollution and the depletion of natural resources are ____.
options: the main causes of improved health
the two main ways technology has damaged the world
the two main benefits of biology
questions.correctAnswer: the two main ways technology has damaged the world

questions.question: An increase in productivity in agriculture helps in ____.
Technological products and their applications in various fields of study have ____.
options: solved societal problems and had significant societal and environmental impacts
questions.correctAnswer: solved societal problems and had significant societal and environmental impacts

questions.question: Which of the following is a negative impact of technology on the natural world?
options: Pollution of clean air by industrial emissions
Improving the supply of clean water
questions.correctAnswer: Pollution of clean air by industrial emissions

questions.question: The predetermined practice of selecting only male (XY) children in society is ____.
options: a negative impact of biology on the society and the natural world
questions.correctAnswer: a negative impact of biology on the society and the natural world

questions.question: Depletion of natural resources is one of the two main ways in which ____.
options: technology has damaged the natural world
questions.correctAnswer: technology has damaged the natural world

questions.question: According to the unit summary, the impacts of biology and technology on society and the natural world are ____.
options: the total number of scientific journals published each year
ways to increase the speed of industrial machines
methods of classifying living organisms into kingdoms
positive and negative influences of using biologically derived technologies
questions.correctAnswer: positive and negative influences of using biologically derived technologies

questions.question: Which of the following is a positive impact of biology on the natural world?
options: Industrial emissions that pollute the air
Improved supply of clean water and energy
questions.correctAnswer: Improved supply of clean water and energy

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a negative impact of technology?
options: Ensuring food security through increased productivity
Creating antibiotics to treat bacterial infections
Improving health and longevity through medicine

questions.question: The misuse and destruction of the natural environment is a consequence of ____.
options: the discovery of antibiotics to treat infections

questions.question: Industrial emissions and effluents that pollute clean air and drinking water are examples of ____.
According to the textbook review questions, industrial wastes are referred to as ____.
Selecting only boys (XY males) and avoiding girls (XX females) through a predetermined limit is a negative impact of ____ on the society and the natural world.
According to the review question, soil fertilizers can cause ____.
According to the textbook, technology is part of ____.
options: only the life of medical doctors

questions.question: In Inquiry activity 1.4, students invite professionals from the ____ to participate in the discussion.
In Inquiry activity 1.4, students are expected to find ____ for the identified impacts.
Industrial emissions and effluents are given as examples of ____.
options: benefits of biology to human health
impacts of technology on the society and the natural world
questions.correctAnswer: impacts of technology on the society and the natural world
